scripts.dev: nodemon --watch . --ext js,json --ignore node_modules --ignore sandbox/sessions --ignore sandbox/builds server.js
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'); for (const d of ['darwin-arm64','darwin-x64','linux-arm64','linux-x64']) { const f=p.join('node_modules','node-pty','prebuilds',d,'spawn-helper'); if (fs.existsSync(f)) { try { fs.chmodSync(f,0o755); } catch(_) {} } }"
